reviews.text: The workers are the best !! They did what they kould to have my dog healthy & strong . & I love them for that .. definitely a place to kome bring ur pets .. plus was understanding with my financial pay ..

I always take my babies here for their vaccinations and flea treatment. The staff on the phone are always very nice and helpful. Victor Vet Tech is always so kind and he handles my doggies and cats very carefully and with care, he is a wonderful nurse! I recommend this animal clinic!

Update: My appointment was cancelled as retaliation. Due to my honest “yelp” review. I stand by what I said. Instead of the owner reaching out, staff called to say the owner didn’t believe me. Wow right? 0 stars if I could. The manager I complained about “investigated“ the complaint. What a joke after spending so much money!

I was referred to as “sir” multilpe times over the phone, regardless of correcting the manager. Informing her that I was a woman.

The manager is rude. The place is filthy. Staff is disorganized and doesn’t talk to people professionally. Not sure if I’m having this experience due to my skin color or my obvious sexuality… but this week is my last appointment.

Ive tried giving this place so many chances. Making excuses for how my dog & I have been treated but it’s always an issue here. I’m fed up & have been searching for another location to introduce my dog to. A place that’s more accepting, cleaner and friendly towards EVERYONE.
Dr. Reyna is awesome! So kind and empathetic and an excellent vet. in fact, the entire staff led by manager Chavez is outstanding.
The staff at this place are half asleep; they don't even have the courtesy to answer calls. I don't recommend it.
Standing in for Altadena Pet Hospital sidelined by fires - VERY helpful and understanding, immaculate facilities.

Horrible service. Had to take my Doberman there due to the Altadena Hospital is not open due to the recent fire. Had a 10:30 appointment waited over an hour to see the doctor who was the only one working. Awaiting to hear back about my dog bloodwork has been  3 days and had to call them which they mentioned that the doctor would get back to me. Incompetent staff. Don’t answer their phone. Late opening up the clinic. Would go to another hospital but my Vet doctor is currently working there due to recent Eaton fire. Will be glad when the Altadena Hospital Clinic is opened and back in business
My appointment is at 12, they haven't called me yet, there's no shade, the sun is strong, you have to wait outside.
Did not take walk ins. Made an appointment,  they delayed the appointment 40 minutes without notice,  no shade, no water no seating.

Wonderful place to take your fur babies! I take my two pups here for vaccines. Staff is quick, informative, and very attentive. If your ever in fear of a vet office, consider this one! Love love love!
They never answer the phone or return voicemails
Very caring and loving towards the owners' pets
I am very grateful to them; they will always be the best for me and my animals. They take excellent care of them.
